action.instructions: Which one action does the browser take for the user's words? Each option is a whole action: a numbered ref with what is done to it, or a verb that needs no ref. Choose none when the words are not a command.

options.navigate: go to a web address the words name: a website, a host or a url
options.search: search for the words: on the web, or on this site when they point at something on it
options.back: go back to the previous page
options.press: press a key: enter, escape, space or an arrow key
options.read: read the page aloud or show its contents
options.clear: clear the text in the focused field
options.stop: stop what the browser is doing
options.none: not a command for this page: a remark, a question, a name, noise
options.play: music: find a song or video by the words and play it now, on YouTube or on this site as the words point — never the page's play button, which is a click
options.play_next: music: find a song by the words and play it after the one playing
options.queue: music: find a song by the words and add it to the end of the queue
options.say_time: appliance: say the time and date — 17:07, Friday 23 October
options.say_weather: appliance: say today's weather in London, the home city — words naming another place or a website are a search, not this — London: 13°C, partly cloudy now; today high 15°C, low 8°C, rain 20%
options.say_playing: appliance: say the song playing — nothing playing
options.say_timer: appliance: say how long is left on the timer — no timer set
options.resume: reopen the last page the screen showed: "BBC News - Home"
options.settings: app setting: change one of the app's settings — ad blocking, appearance (light or dark mode), the clock (12- or 24-hour), seconds on the clock, the date format, the first day of the week, the idle timeout, night dimming, web page zoom, the weather city and units, the voice, the Idle Screen's cards, the upload folder
options.panel_open: app: open the activity panel, the feed of what was said and done — now closed, overlay, 536 px wide
options.panel_close: app: close the activity panel, hiding it — now closed, overlay, 536 px wide
options.panel_overlay: app: float the activity panel over the page — now closed, overlay, 536 px wide
options.panel_docked: app: dock the activity panel beside the page, in its own room — now closed, overlay, 536 px wide
options.panel_width: app: change the activity panel's width: wider, narrower or to the pixels the words carry, the amount Choice saying which and how far — now closed, overlay, 536 px wide
options.show_dashboard: app: show the browser, leaving Settings or the Weight page — now showing the browser
options.show_weight: app: show the Weight page, the weigh-ins — now showing the browser
options.show_settings: app: show the Settings page — now showing the browser
options.show_settings_voice: app: show the Settings page at its Voice section — now showing the browser
options.show_settings_learned_terms: app: show the Settings page at its Speech vocabulary section — now showing the browser
options.show_settings_appearance: app: show the Settings page at its Appearance section — now showing the browser
options.show_settings_browsing: app: show the Settings page at its Browsing section — now showing the browser
options.show_settings_idle_screen_cards: app: show the Settings page at its Cards section — now showing the browser
options.show_settings_clock: app: show the Settings page at its Clock section — now showing the browser
options.show_settings_screen: app: show the Settings page at its Screen section — now showing the browser
options.show_settings_weather: app: show the Settings page at its Weather section — now showing the browser
options.show_settings_weight: app: show the Settings page at its Weight section — now showing the browser
options.show_settings_ai_usage: app: show the Settings page at its AI usage section — now showing the browser
options.show_settings_environment: app: show the Settings page at its Environment section — now showing the browser

slot.instructions: Which words of the transcript are the thing the command carries verbatim: the address to open, the search terms, the song to play, the text to type, the key to press? Never the command word itself: "play X" carries X. A line with no command word, such as a question, carries itself: its search terms are the line as asked. Choose none when it carries none.

options.none: the command carries no words of its own

extent.instructions: Only when the action scrolls the page or a scrolling part of it: how far? Choose words when the words give a number of screens or pages; screen when they say nothing of how far. Ignored for every other action.

options.words: as many screens as the number the words carry
options.little: a little: a third of a screen
options.screen: one screen, as Page Down does
options.end: all the way: to the bottom, or to the top going up

amount.instructions: Only when the action skips forward or back in a video or audio, changes its volume or speed, or changes an app number (a setting's amount, the panel's width): how far? For a skip, choose words when the words say how far — a number of seconds, or of minutes; otherwise the share of its length the words mean. For a volume, a speed or an app number, choose to when the words carry the level, else up or down and how far. Ignored for every other action.

options.words: as far as the words say: the number they carry, in seconds, or in minutes when they say minutes
options.moment: a moment: a hundredth of its length
options.little: a little: a twentieth of its length
options.chunk: a chunk: a tenth of its length
options.lot: a lot: a quarter of its length
options.end: all the way: to the end, or back to the start
options.to: the volume, speed or app number to the number the words carry
options.up-little: the volume, speed or app number up a little
options.up-step: the volume, speed or app number up a step
options.up-lot: the volume, speed or app number up a lot
options.up-all: the volume, speed or app number up as far as it goes
options.down-little: the volume, speed or app number down a little
options.down-step: the volume, speed or app number down a step
options.down-lot: the volume, speed or app number down a lot
options.down-all: the volume, speed or app number down as far as it goes
